summary.text: Terry Wilson is a Republican member of the Texas House of Representatives who has represented District 20 since 2017 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
A retired U.S. Army colonel, he said in a Ballotpedia survey that he chairs the House Committee on Higher Education.

paragraphs.text: Terry Wilson was born in Odessa, Texas, and served in the U.S. Army from 1983 to 2015.
He earned a bachelor's degree from Texas A&M University in 1990 and a graduate degree from the Air War College in 2003.
Ballotpedia lists affiliations with the National Rifle Association and Rotary.

Wilson first assumed office in 2017, and his committee assignments have included Criminal Jurisprudence and Defense & Veterans' Affairs in 2017, Appropriations and Higher Education in 2019-2020, and Appropriations and Natural Resources in 2021-2022.
In 2023-2024 he chaired the Defense & Veterans' Affairs Committee and also served on Agriculture and Livestock.

In a 2026 survey, he said he also serves on the Elections and Redistricting committees, was appointed chair of the House Select Committee on Civil Discourse & Freedom of Speech in Higher Education during special sessions of the 89th Legislature, and previously chaired the Article III subcommittee of Appropriations.

He said his priorities include lowering property taxes and the cost of insurance and health care, and building workforce training programs, and he named water, education, national defense and public safety as policy areas he is passionate about.
